title: Objective Autonomous Loop live flowchart dashboard (frontend-only observability; zero backend/runtime changes)
description: BASE 07f22db. Adds a read-only Autonomous Loop observability section to the existing Objective Detail page: a real node-and-edge SVG flowchart (15-node spine OBJECTIVE/POLICY → DURABLE WAKE → SCHEDULER → CLAIM/LEASE → DRIVER ADMISSION → OPERATING PASS → CEO → WORKSTREAM ALLOCATION → PLANNER → MISSION OPEN → EXECUTION → ARTIFACTS/EVIDENCE → REVIEW → SCHEDULER SETTLEMENT → CONTINUATION, plus a continuation→wake loop edge and five evidence-gated side branches BLOCKED/WAITING/RETRY/DENIED-FAULT/OWNER-ACTION), zoom/pan/fit, click-to-inspect evidence panel, per-endpoint freshness, and read-only scheduler/driver/missions detail panels. Pure deterministic derive layer (deriveLoopSnapshot et al.) implements authority rules A–G: lease proves claim not admission (fence/generation correlation), history never presented as current-cycle progress, no per-cycle settlement fabrication, INTEGRITY_FAULT coexisting with older success, separate next_due/lease/policy time concepts. Live data: two new typed GET reads (auto-scheduler, auto-driver) polled on the existing 5s visible-page cadence with abort + atMs staleness guards and the same fail-closed objective-identity contract as the canonical auto-policy read. 22-scenario vitest file proves the derivation contract; Playwright spec proves real-stack rendering, inspector, honest endpoint failure, and no cross-objective leakage. NOTE: the test file lives at src/__tests__/ because the harness executes `npx vitest run <selector>` under the root vitest config (include: src/__tests__/**) — the tested module has zero runtime imports and stays inside apps/mission-control-ui. Zero production-runtime changes: UI surface only, no new endpoints, no mutations, no dependency changes, no lockfile changes.
